t: Which Harmonica to Buy? – The Best & Worst Harmonicas
s: December 9, 2019 - The priciest non-customized harmonica I recommend is the Hohner Crossover. As much as I love it though, I actually have grown to prefer the more reasonably priced Marine Band Deluxe. The tuning sounds sweeter than the Crossover when playing chords, and I also find the tone to be slightly warmer. I recommend buying them from Rockin’ Rons.
